verdict.rationale: Increase is an API-first banking product, so API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question. The evidence pack never documents API versions or a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI spec probe and the mention of Entity validations 'for each version of the data' refer to an adjacent spec artifact and to data versioning, not API version or deprecation guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
